goal: Keep the product independent from the maintainer's generic SDLC tools while preserving a traceable development and release loop.
source: User: 流程不要和项目耦合，除非范式要求这么做

acceptance.requirement: Product tests and verification run without an active task or external workflow toolkit.
Reusable host review and Hook tools live outside the product and accept the project as input.
Project CI, release and maintenance remain independently operable with project-specific records preserved.

nonGoals: Publishing a second framework repository without a request
